BiblicalUsage: Called means chosen and named: these were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, and Dathan and Abiram were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and Aaron.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that being called by name is both honour and responsibility, because Dathan and Abiram were famous and still fell.
